question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**biggest**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes the savanna, particularly mentioning Africa's savannas.
 
• The adjective in the blank should describe the scale or size of the savannas in Africa.
 
• "**Biggest**" is the most appropriate word because it refers to the vast size of the African savannas.
 
• Other options like "**cleverest**", "**fattest**", and "**heaviest**" do not logically fit the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Cleverest (सबसे चालाक): "Cleverest" means the most intelligent, which does not fit the context of discussing size.
 
• Fattest (सबसे मोटा): "Fattest" means the most overweight, which does not align with the general comparison of size.
 
• Heaviest (सबसे भारी): "Heaviest" means the most weighty, which does not specifically denote the largest in size.
